name: Firebase Studio
tagline: Agentic cloud IDE for building and shipping full-stack AI apps with Gemini.
description: Firebase Studio is Google's cloud-based, agentic development environment for building and shipping full-stack AI apps from the browser. It unifies the former Project IDX with Gemini-powered agents and the Genkit framework, giving you a full Code OSS editor, app prototyping from natural-language prompts, emulators, and one-click deploy to Firebase App Hosting. It runs entirely in the browser with no local setup. The core environment is free, with optional paid Cloud Billing for hosting and higher quotas.
insight: Evolved from and replaced Google's earlier Project IDX cloud IDE, relaunched with Gemini agents in 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Powered by Google's Gemini models via Genkit.

edge: Free and fully browser-based with no local setup, tying a real Code OSS editor straight into Gemini agents and the Firebase deploy stack.
pros: Runs fully in the browser, no setup
Gemini agents and Genkit built in
cons: Workspace limits on the free tier
